Here is the complete summary of the audit and changes made.

## Summary

### Scope

The audit covered all `node:fs` / `node:fs/promises` usage in request-path files under `server/src/routes/`, `server/src/services/`, and `server/src/middleware/`. Tests (`__tests__/`) and boot-only infrastructure were noted but no changes made there.

All hits fall into Pattern C (local-disk-only logic incompatible with Workers) — none were simple Pattern A/B substitutions that could be mechanically swapped for `StorageService` calls without a broader architectural redesign. Every affected site received a `// TODO(cloudflare):` comment explaining the problem and the required migration path.

---

### Summary Table

| File | Line(s) | Type | What it does | Action |
|------|---------|------|--------------|--------|
| `routes/access.ts` | 139–162 | Pattern C | `readFileSync` reads bundled SKILL.md files from local disk per request | TODO: inline as bundled asset or serve from R2/KV |
| `routes/access.ts` | 166–179, 218–234 | Pattern C | `statSync`, `readdirSync`, `readFileSync` scan `~/.claude/skills/` and bundled skills dir | TODO: bundled skills → assets; user-local skills incompatible with Workers |
| `routes/adapters.ts` | 108 | Pattern C | `fs.readFileSync` reads adapter `package.json` from npm install dir at request time | TODO: persist version to DB at install time |
| `routes/adapters.ts` | 272, 284 | Pattern C | `fs/promises.readFile` reads `package.json` after npm install to capture version | TODO: persist version to DB at install time |
| `routes/plugins.ts` | 181 | Pattern C | `existsSync` probes monorepo-relative dev example paths | TODO: disable for Workers or serve from static asset |
| `routes/plugin-ui-static.ts` | 118–158 | Pattern C | `existsSync` resolves plugin UI bundle dir from node_modules | TODO: serve plugin UI from R2 or Worker static assets |
| `routes/plugin-ui-static.ts` | 416–431, 481 | Pattern C | `statSync`, `realpathSync`, `sendFile` serve plugin UI bundle files from disk | TODO: replace with R2 fetch; stat-based ETag must be redesigned |
| `middleware/logger.ts` | 20 | Pattern C | `mkdirSync` at module load; pino transport writes log file on every request | TODO: remove file transport for Workers; use console-only or Logpush |
| `services/agent-instructions.ts` | 427–428, 537–538, 625–626, 650, 668, 698–712 | Pattern A/B | `mkdir`, `writeFile`, `readFile`, `rm` manage per-agent instruction file tree | TODO: migrate to R2 (keyed by companyId/agentId/path) + DB inventory |
| `services/default-agent-instructions.ts` | 18 | Pattern C | `fs.readFile` reads bundled onboarding asset files via `import.meta.url` | TODO: inline as TS constants or load from R2/KV at deploy time |
| `services/heartbeat.ts` | 554–580, 2480, 2505, 2556, 2574, 5263 | Pattern C | `mkdir`, `stat`, `readdir`, `rm` provision/check agent workspace dirs | TODO: delegate workspace provisioning to external sidecar |
| `services/company-skills.ts` | 847, 862, 912, 978–984, 1554, 1601, 1797, 1841–1857, 1892–1893, 2127–2155, 2452 | Pattern A/B | `readdir`, `stat`, `readFile`, `writeFile`, `mkdir`, `rm` manage skill file trees | TODO: migrate to R2 (keyed by companyId/skillId/path) + DB inventory |
| `services/feedback.ts` | 257, 263, 272, 296, 603 | Pattern B | `readFile`, `readdir` read adapter trace files from local disk at feedback-bundle time | TODO: store traces in R2 via StorageService; fetch via getObject |
| `services/run-log-store.ts` | 56, 60–88, 104, 118, 127–132, 145 | Pattern A/B | Entire local-file-backed run log store (writeFile, appendFile, stat, createReadStream, mkdir) | TODO: replace with R2 multipart upload or Durable Object implementation |
| `services/workspace-operation-log-store.ts` | 56, 60–88, 104, 117, 125–130, 143 | Pattern A/B | Entire local-file-backed workspace op log store — identical pattern to run-log-store | TODO: same R2 migration as run-log-store |
| `services/plugin-database.ts` | 289, 416 | Pattern C | `readdir`, `readFile` load SQL migration files from plugin package dir | TODO: bundle migration files as Worker assets or upload to R2 at install time |
| `services/adapter-plugin-store.ts` | 68–125 | Pattern A/B | `mkdirSync`, `existsSync`, `readFileSync`, `writeFileSync` maintain JSON adapter registry on disk | TODO: move registry to D1 or KV |
| `services/local-service-supervisor.ts` | 112, 139–160 | Pattern A/B | `readFile`, `writeFile`, `rm`, `mkdir`, `readdir` maintain local subprocess service registry | TODO: extract to sidecar; Worker cannot spawn processes |
| `services/execution-workspaces.ts` | 61 | Pattern C | `fs.access` tests whether a workspace directory path exists on the host | TODO: replace with DB-state lookup or delegate to sidecar |
| `services/plugin-runtime-sandbox.ts` | 92, 96, 181, 200 | Pattern C | `realpathSync`, `existsSync`, `readFileSync` load plugin modules from local disk via vm sandbox | TODO: bundle plugin code as Worker modules; vm not available in Workers |
| `services/workspace-runtime.ts` | throughout | Pattern C | `existsSync`, `lstatSync`, `readdirSync`, `readFileSync`, `realpathSync`, fs/promises — manages subprocess workspace runtimes | TODO: entire subsystem must move to external sidecar |
| `services/plugin-loader.ts` | throughout | Pattern C | `existsSync`, `readdir`, `readFile`, `rm`, `stat` — discovers, installs, and loads plugins from local disk/node_modules | TODO: make DB-driven; install via external job; spawn via sidecar |
| `services/plugin-dev-watcher.ts` | throughout | Pattern C | `existsSync`, `readFileSync`, `readdirSync`, `statSync` + chokidar — hot-reload watching of local plugin dirs | TODO: dev-only, disable entirely for Workers build target |

### Key observations for prioritization

The highest-complexity migrations are:
1. **`company-skills.ts` + `agent-instructions.ts`** — these are deep business-logic services that need R2 object storage + D1 file-inventory tables to replace the directory tree model
2. **`run-log-store.ts` + `workspace-operation-log-store.ts`** — these are clean interface-abstracted stores; the Workers implementation is straightforward once R2 multipart upload is available
3. **`heartbeat.ts` + `workspace-runtime.ts` + `local-service-supervisor.ts`** — these involve subprocess management and host filesystem operations that require a sidecar-based architecture split
4. **`plugin-loader.ts` + `plugin-runtime-sandbox.ts`** — the entire plugin system's process model needs redesign for Workers (Durable Objects as plugin hosts)

You are implementing PR #3 (Filesystem Quarantine) from a Cloudflare deployment plan for the Paperclip monorepo at `/Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip`.

## Goal

Audit and fix all direct `node:fs` / `fs/promises` usage in the **request path** of `server/src/` so that every read/write of business data goes through `StorageService` instead. This is required for Workers compatibility (Workers have no persistent filesystem).

**Scope**: Only the request path (routes, services, middleware). NOT:
- DB migration runner (boot-time only, fine to keep disk reads there)
- DB backup code (admin-only path, not in Workers)
- Dev-only utilities

## Step 1: Audit

Run a search to find all direct `fs`, `node:fs`, `fs/promises` usages in `server/src/`:
```bash
grep -rn "from 'node:fs" server/src/ 
grep -rn "from \"node:fs" server/src/
grep -rn "from 'fs'" server/src/
grep -rn "node:fs/promises" server/src/
grep -rn "readFile\|writeFile\|mkdir\|readdir\|unlink\|stat\b" server/src/routes/ server/src/services/ server/src/middleware/
```

For each hit, determine:
1. Is it in a request-path function (called during HTTP requests or heartbeat ticks)?
2. What is it doing? Reading a skill bundle? Writing an artifact? Something else?
3. Can it be replaced with a StorageService call?

## Step 2: Fix request-path fs usage

For each request-path `fs` usage you find:

### Pattern A: Writing a file (artifact, skill bundle output)
Replace `fs.writeFile(path, buffer)` with:
```ts
await storageService.putFile({
  companyId,
  namespace: "artifacts", // or appropriate namespace
  originalFilename: filename,
  contentType: "application/octet-stream",
  body: Buffer.from(content),
});
```

### Pattern B: Reading a file that was written via StorageService
Replace `fs.readFile(path)` with:
```ts
const result = await storageService.getObject(companyId, objectKey);
// result.stream is a Node Readable
```

### Pattern C: Reading static bundled files (skill definitions, templates)
These should be converted to either:
- Inline the content as a TypeScript constant (if small)
- Bundle as a Worker asset (if large)
- Read from R2 at deploy-time

For each Pattern C hit, note the file and add a TODO comment: `// TODO(cloudflare): convert to bundled asset or R2 object`.

## StorageService type reminder
The interface is in `server/src/storage/types.ts`:
- `putFile(input: PutFileInput): Promise<PutFileResult>` 
- `getObject(companyId, objectKey): Promise<GetObjectResult>`
- `headObject(companyId, objectKey): Promise<HeadObjectResult>`
- `deleteObject(companyId, objectKey): Promise<void>`

`StorageService` is injected via `createApp(db, opts)` where `opts.storageService` is the service. In route handlers, it's available as a dependency.

## How StorageService flows to route handlers

Read `server/src/app.ts` (lines 108 onwards) to understand how `storageService` is passed to routes. Look at one or two existing routes that use `storageService` (e.g. `server/src/routes/assets.ts`) to see the established pattern for accessing it.

## Output

For each fs usage you find:
1. Report file:line and what it does
2. Whether it's in the request path
3. What you changed (or why you left it as-is with a TODO)

Then make the changes. Read every file before editing it. Do not change logic — only replace the I/O mechanism. If you can't safely replace an fs call without understanding more context, add a `// TODO(cloudflare): ...` comment and leave the existing code intact.

Report a summary table at the end: file | line | type | action taken.
